# RC-2 takes *3,116 hours* over three phases, a third of them in Phase 1.

The fictional RC-2 roaster plan: 96 work items in three phases, each with an owner, a likely and a high estimate, and its labour at the team's rates.

## Every work item, by phase and package

Petra Saldana carries the most items; <a href="#plan?f.owner=JV">Jonas Vireo's work</a> is mostly firmware, and <a href="#plan?view=table&sort=-labour">the costliest items</a> are hardware.
